profile.headline: Software Engineer | TypeScript, React, Node.js, AWS | Cloud Architecture & Scalable Systems
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer energized by architectural design. I enjoy figuring out how a system should be built before the first line of code is written, and building systems to scale. That instinct took me from full-stack web development (React, Node, Express) into deeper systems, infrastructure, and cloud computing work, primarily on AWS.

Open to conversations about architecture, systems design, or where AI agents are headed in engineering.

positions.title: Research and Development I
positions.description:
Full stack software engineer working on all aspects of a web application, including the frontend, backend & scalable services on the Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

This web application was a prototype of mine, that turned into a scalable production application that is a core tool in our product for a large emerging market in e-commerce.
This application was built using React, Express, GCP, BigQuery & Looker.

Introduced multi-stage environments using modern CI/CD processes & tools. Introduced unit testing as well.

Currently transitioning to a lead role, where I assist teammates with their work & provide guidance on how to tackle problems.

positions.title: Google Cloud Platform Student Innovator
positions.description:
Host and Organize student events to bring awareness to the Google Cloud Platform.
Trained by Google employees at Student Innovator Summit at Google(Mountain View Campus)
Developed communication and inter-personal skills while endorsing and teaching the platform.

volunteerExperiences.description: I took care of kids in a apartment complex for a after school program. I helped them with their homework, did art, played outside, and helped them with any problems they had.

projects.title: Indeed/Craigslist Slackbot
projects.description:
A slackbot that scrapes job listings from both Indeed and Craigslist. Puts them in a database, and sends them to my slack channel. Highly customizable, and easy to get started.

A full web application was created to show results, and allows user to customize search settings with ease.

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.description: Portfolio Website created from scratch. Made with HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JQuery, Flask and SQLAlchemy. Deployed on Google App Engine.
